description: Draws as a card and installs the card item: compose PreviewCardContent from CardSubject, CardFacts and CardFooter in place of your own paragraphs. It takes the card radius and its inset hairline in place of the 10px radius and border. Its name and description are not truncated. CardAction and CardExplain throw inside it.

Renamed from field-card: install preview-card and import PreviewCard, PreviewCardTrigger and PreviewCardContent from @/components/preview-card. The enter scale token is now --preview-card-enter-scale.
The docs link to this item's playground page at /playground/components/field-card.
Assessed against the lifecycle criteria: beta. Its design critique is not yet clean: the card has no keyboard or touch route of its own (issue #42).
Installs into your components folder, so import it from @/components.
Merges class names with the cn item, so a className override replaces a token utility.
Takes its shadow, layer, duration and opening scale from the tokens item.
